item.title: Fix window.py bug so python3 -m unittest passes for all inputs
item.brief: In this repository `python3 -m unittest` currently fails. Find and fix the bug in `window.py` so every test passes. Do not change the tests. The function must be correct for every input, not only the tested ones: check boundary cases (empty input, single element, window size equal to or larger than the input, off-by-one indexing at both ends) and fix the root cause. Add assertions only where they catch plausible bugs. Commit the fix on the local branch with a clear message; do not push.

reasons: sizer: ordinary -> medium; unchanged: the learned route's effort

state.summary:
Fixed the off-by-one in window.py: sliding_windows used range(len(items) - size), which dropped the final window, so [1,2] with size 2 returned [] instead of [[1,2]]. The range is now range(len(items) - size + 1). Inputs shorter than size still return []. Committed as 822acab on archon/2j96r5c2-fix-window-py-bug-so-python3-m-unittest under the configured identity mengsig; nothing pushed. Tests were not changed. Before: `python3 -m unittest` ran 3 tests, 2 failing. After: 3 tests OK. Boundary probe: s([],1)=[], s([1],1)=[[1]], s([1],2)=[], s([1,2],2)=[[1,2]], s([1,2,3],1)=[[1],[2],[3]], s([1,2,3],3)=[[1,2,3]], s([1,2,3],2)=[[1,2],[2,3]]. The repo has no linter or build step. No services were started. Open: none. Review: one low-effort reviewer (agt_01M88QZEXWPB6BMSVNQYW9E6QV) read the whole one-line change and passed it with no findings. Risk low: one-line off-by-one fix, covered by tests. Assertions were considered and not added: a length assert would be decorative. Review: pass by agt_01M88QZEXWPB6BMSVNQYW9E6QV

pr.summary: Made sliding_windows return every window. Now: the final window is included, and [1,2] with size 2 gives [[1,2]]. Before: the last window was dropped, so that case gave [].
pr.title: Fix off-by-one that dropped the last sliding window
